<includeonly><tr><td>{{{anchors|}}}{{{seller|Unknown}}}</td><td>{{Item|{{{item|}}}}}</td>{{#if:{{{quantity|}}}|<td>{{{quantity}}}</td>}}{{#if:{{{price|}}}|<td>{{{price}}}</td>}}{{#if:{{{currency|}}}|<td>{{{currency}}}</td>}}{{#if:{{{location|}}}|<td>{{{location}}}</td>}}{{#if:{{{conditions|}}}|<td>{{{conditions}}}</td>}}</tr>
</includeonly><noinclude>
A row for a merchant's wares table. Required item is a canonical title; seller is a linked name. Optional quantity, price, currency, location and conditions add cells in that order. Omit a field only when its column is absent; otherwise use "Unknown" for an unknown value.

<pre>{{Ware row|seller=[[Magus Clay]]|item=Iron Hand Axe|price=&lt;noinclude&gt;{{:Iron Hand Axe}}&lt;/noinclude&gt;}}</pre>
Standard prices stay transcluded from the item, whose price view uses Coins. Keep the literal noinclude gate in the merchant's source, NOT inside this always-transcluded template, and apply the same gate to the table header. Filtered seller views must not include the item price again. In a mixed-price table, the owner supplies an includeonly "Standard item price" link for standard-price rows; genuine vendor exceptions may use a nested Coins call. Location/story/shared-stock disclosures stay once per owning section, not copied into every row.
</noinclude>
